rule: Missing, denied or failed evidence never yields PASS; recognition is not coverage; a scanner or SCC finding is never an approved vulnerability.

outcome_mapping.COMPLETE: SUCCEEDED; residual pagination token -> PARTIAL coverage
outcome_mapping.PARTIAL: SUCCEEDED with TRUNCATED pagination -> PARTIAL coverage
outcome_mapping.NOT_ENABLED: AWS-defined absence code -> derived absence evidence; otherwise FAILED (coverage ERROR)

journal.multi_page_responses: merged into .closec-derived/ with source page SHA-256s

providers.integrity: checksums.sha256 must list every file; mismatch or omission fails closed
2.2 requires checksums.sha256; 2.1 and pilot packages require an explicit acknowledgment that no source checksums exist
